title.zh: Bitget Reopens Bitcoin Withdrawals After $387.5 Million Breach
title.en: Bitget Reopens Bitcoin Withdrawals After $387.5 Million Breach

current_state.zh: Bitget has restored Bitcoin withdrawals after a $387.5 million breach, with ETH and USDT withdrawals still paused and the CEO pledging to top up the protection fund above $300 million this week.
